aspects.name: Primary-source and paper quality
aspects.feedback: The central claims use two official NIST AI RMF resources and an IETF Standards Track RFC; the format claim uses the canonical JSON Lines documentation.

aspects.name: Claim-to-source entailment
aspects.feedback: The sources entail the underlying requirements for documented test sets, criteria, intended use, UUID properties, and JSONL records. The exact course schema, polarity, and read-back check are accurately disclosed as inferences.

aspects.name: Coverage of planned concepts and failure modes
aspects.feedback: The artifact covers all four user stories, including observable criteria, label semantics, stable identity, JSONL, and missing or duplicate identity. It does not provide evidence for the plan's required both-class validation check.

aspects.name: Citation completeness and resolvability
aspects.feedback: All four URLs resolved and every material claim has a linked source. CLM-L01-003's locator additionally names Measure 2.3 although its sole source record is the NIST Valid and Reliable page.

aspects.name: Technical accuracy and appropriate qualifications
aspects.feedback: The claims preserve scope and limitations, particularly that UUIDs are optional and the four fields and 1/0 convention are course decisions. The unsupported both-class validation rationale prevents a top rating.

aspects.name: Seminal/recent source balance
aspects.feedback: All sources are current (2023-2025) and suitable, but the handoff contains no seminal evaluation or dataset-quality source to complement the current standards.

aspects.name: Builder-ready structured handoff
aspects.feedback: The JSON is parseable and separates sources, claims, scopes, limitations, inferences, user-story links, coverage, and known evidence gaps.

deterministic_checks.expected: Every material claim has at least one resolvable source.
deterministic_checks.actual: 6/6 claims have a linked resolvable source (100%); CLM-L01-003 has one locator inconsistency noted separately.

deterministic_checks.method: Supplied deterministic source-authority result and direct source verification.
deterministic_checks.expected: At least 80% of central claims have primary or authoritative support.
deterministic_checks.actual: 6/6 central claims have primary or authoritative support (100%).

deterministic_checks.expected: Duplicate records are identified and the duplicate rate is reported.
Required title, authors, year, source type, URL, and authority note are present.

deterministic_checks.method: Compare research coverage with the four approved plan user stories and their acceptance criteria.
deterministic_checks.expected: Every approved plan concept has adequate evidence, with gaps identified.
deterministic_checks.actual: 4/4 user stories are marked covered, but no claim supports the required representation-of-both-classes validation in US-L01-04.

deterministic_checks.expected: The research artifact parses as JSON.
deterministic_checks.actual: Supplied deterministic result: PASS (EP-01, 4 sources, 6 claims).

deterministic_checks.method: Attempt strict validation against research.schema.json using jsonschema.
deterministic_checks.expected: The schema validator executes against the candidate.
deterministic_checks.actual: NOT RUN because the jsonschema package is unavailable; this is disclosed rather than treated as passing.

evidence.observation: All four URLs resolved in direct review. NIST and IETF are authoritative standards sources; JSON Lines is the format's canonical documentation.
The supplied result reports 6/6 central claims supported by a primary or authoritative source (100%).

evidence.locator: NIST AI RMF Core Measure 2.1 and 2.3; Valid and Reliable section 3.1
evidence.observation: NIST requires documentation of test sets, metrics, and TEVV-tool details, measures performance or assurance criteria under relevant conditions, and defines validation against requirements for a specific intended use.

evidence.locator: RFC 9562 abstract and sections 1-2.1; JSON Lines sections 1-3
evidence.observation: RFC 9562 defines UUID uniqueness, persistence, and use without central registration; JSON Lines specifies UTF-8, one valid JSON value per line, and newline terminators.
Six claims link the four user stories to source IDs, scopes, limitations, and explicit inference flags; all four coverage records are marked covered.

The stated inferences cover the exact four-field schema and JSONL read-back comparison, while evidence_gaps acknowledges no evidence for a universal class-balance threshold; no claim addresses the plan's required both-class presence check.

evidence.locator: claim/source linkage; duplicate and metadata checks
evidence.observation: The supplied result reports 6/6 linked claims, 0/4 duplicates, and 0 sources missing required metadata.
CLM-L01-003 cites only SRC-L01-NIST-VALIDITY but its locator names both section 3.1 and Measure 2.3; Measure 2.3 belongs to SRC-L01-NIST-MEASURE.
The weighted scores sum to 84; no observable workflow behavior supports a fixed penalty.

strengths: [EV-SJ-L01-003] The NIST sources directly support explicit criteria, documented test sets, and intended-use qualification.
[EV-SJ-L01-004] The RFC and JSON Lines claims accurately keep UUID and read-back choices within their stated limits.
[EV-SJ-L01-005] The structured handoff is immediately usable by the builder because every claim has scope, limitations, and a user-story link.

defects.problem: The research marks US-L01-04 covered without support for its required check that both label classes are represented.
defects.consequence: The builder has no research-backed rationale for one of the plan's explicit downstream-safety validations.
defects.acceptance_condition: Add a resolvable authoritative or primary source and a scoped claim linked to US-L01-04 that supports checking representation of both outcome classes for this binary evaluation dataset, or mark US-L01-04 partial and explicitly bound the builder to the plan's course decision rather than presenting it as researched evidence.

defects.problem: The source locator names Measure 2.3 although SRC-L01-NIST-MEASURE is absent from source_ids.
defects.consequence: A builder cannot resolve the full locator from the claim's declared source list.
defects.acceptance_condition: Either add SRC-L01-NIST-MEASURE to CLM-L01-003.source_ids or remove Measure 2.3 from its locator and support text.

qualitative_feedback: Targeted revision. The research is compact, authoritative, and well-qualified, with all supplied linkage, authority, duplicate, metadata, US coverage, and JSON-parse results disclosed. Remediate the unsupported both-class validation concept and repair the mixed-source locator; the current score is exactly 84 (84 weighted points minus zero behavioral penalties). The unavailable jsonschema check remains informational and not-run.
